description: Declarative 3-Tier Departmental Venue Affinity & Hard Specialized Lab Sub-Pool Configuration. Tier 1A = Exact Module Preferred Venues; Tier 1B = Cohort Home Venues; Tier 1C = Department Prefix Pool; Tier 2 = General Category Overflow Pool.

Theory / Lecture Room.description: Soft home-turf preference: prioritize Tier 1 (Module / Cohort Home / Dept Prefix) venues before overflowing into the general category pool.

Computer / Digital Lab.description: Soft home-turf preference: prioritize Tier 1 (Module / Cohort Home / Dept Prefix) venues before overflowing into the general category pool.

Engineering / Science Lab.description: Hard departmental sub-pool lock: sessions may only use venues in their module or department prefix pool.
